announcement_archived.name: announcement_archived
announcement_archived.value: "announcement"."archived_at" is null or "announcement"."published_at" is not null

general_assembly_closed.name: general_assembly_closed
general_assembly_closed.value: ("general_assembly"."status" = 'closed') = ("general_assembly"."closed_at" is not null and "general_assembly"."total_shares" is not null)

buyer_nin_unique.name: buyer_nin_unique
buyer_nin_unique.where: "buyer"."nin" is not null and "buyer"."deleted_at" is null

budget_approval.name: budget_approval
budget_approval.value: ("budget"."status" = 'approved') = ("budget"."approved_at" is not null and "budget"."frequency" is not null and "budget"."reserve_fund_bp" is not null)

charge_payment_cancellation.name: charge_payment_cancellation
charge_payment_cancellation.value: ("charge_payment"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("charge_payment"."cancelled_at" is not null and "charge_payment"."cancellation_reason" is not null)

charge_period_cancellation.name: charge_period_cancellation
charge_period_cancellation.value: ("charge_period"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("charge_period"."cancelled_at" is not null and "charge_period"."cancellation_reason" is not null)

handover_signed.name: handover_signed
handover_signed.value:
("handover"."status" = 'signed') = ("handover"."number" is not null and "handover"."signed_on" is not null
        and "handover"."outstanding" is not null and "handover"."reserves" is not null)

online_payment_target.name: online_payment_target
online_payment_target.value: ("online_payment"."purpose" = 'sale') = ("online_payment"."reservation_id" is not null) and ("online_payment"."purpose" = 'charges') = ("online_payment"."residence_id" is not null and "online_payment"."unit_id" is not null)

online_payment_recorded.name: online_payment_recorded
online_payment_recorded.value: ("online_payment"."payment_id" is null or "online_payment"."purpose" = 'sale') and ("online_payment"."charge_payment_id" is null or "online_payment"."purpose" = 'charges')

online_payment_refund.name: online_payment_refund
online_payment_refund.value: ("online_payment"."status" = 'refunded') = ("online_payment"."refunded_at" is not null and "online_payment"."refund_reason" is not null)

portal_link_buyer_key.name: portal_link_buyer_key
portal_link_buyer_key.where: "portal_link"."revoked_at" is null and "portal_link"."buyer_id" is not null

portal_link_resident_key.name: portal_link_resident_key
portal_link_resident_key.where: "portal_link"."revoked_at" is null and "portal_link"."resident_id" is not null

lease_ended.name: lease_ended
lease_ended.value: ("lease"."status" = 'ended') = ("lease"."ended_on" is not null and "lease"."end_reason" is not null)

lease_deposit_settled.name: lease_deposit_settled
lease_deposit_settled.value:
("lease"."deposit_settled_on" is null) = ("lease"."deposit_refunded" is null)
        and ("lease"."deposit_settled_on" is null) = ("lease"."deposit_retained" is null)
        and ("lease"."deposit_refunded" is null or "lease"."deposit_refunded" >= 0)
        and ("lease"."deposit_retained" is null or "lease"."deposit_retained" >= 0)

rent_payment_cancellation.name: rent_payment_cancellation
rent_payment_cancellation.value: ("rent_payment"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("rent_payment"."cancelled_at" is not null and "rent_payment"."cancellation_reason" is not null)

resident_period.name: resident_period
resident_period.value: "resident"."until_on" is null or "resident"."since_on" is null or "resident"."until_on" >= "resident"."since_on"

discount_request_amounts.name: discount_request_amounts
discount_request_amounts.value:
"discount_request"."amount" > 0 and "discount_request"."amount" <= "discount_request"."list_price"
        and ("discount_request"."approved_amount" is null or ("discount_request"."approved_amount" > 0 and "discount_request"."approved_amount" <= "discount_request"."amount"))

discount_request_approval.name: discount_request_approval
discount_request_approval.value: ("discount_request"."status" = 'approved') = ("discount_request"."approved_amount" is not null and "discount_request"."valid_until" is not null)

organization_setting_rates.name: organization_setting_rates
organization_setting_rates.value:
"organization_setting"."withdrawal_retention_bp" between 0 and 10000
        and "organization_setting"."penalty_monthly_rate_bp" between 0 and 1000
        and "organization_setting"."penalty_grace_days" between 0 and 365
        and "organization_setting"."penalty_cap_bp" between 0 and 10000
        and "organization_setting"."default_commission_rate_bp" between 0 and 2000

organization_setting_termination.name: organization_setting_termination
organization_setting_termination.value:
"organization_setting"."formal_notice_days" between 1 and 90
        and "organization_setting"."formal_notices_required" between 1 and 5
        and "organization_setting"."termination_retention_bp" between 0 and 10000

payment_cancellation.name: payment_cancellation
payment_cancellation.value: ("payment"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("payment"."cancelled_at" is not null and "payment"."cancellation_reason" is not null)

payment_plan_step_trigger.name: payment_plan_step_trigger
payment_plan_step_trigger.value:
("payment_plan_step"."trigger" = 'months_after_signing') = ("payment_plan_step"."months" is not null)
        and ("payment_plan_step"."trigger" = 'milestone') = ("payment_plan_step"."milestone_id" is not null)

quotation_cancellation.name: quotation_cancellation
quotation_cancellation.value: ("quotation"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("quotation"."cancelled_at" is not null and "quotation"."cancellation_reason" is not null)

reservation_sale.name: reservation_sale
reservation_sale.value: ("reservation"."status" = 'sold') <= ("reservation"."sale_signed_on" is not null and "reservation"."sale_number" is not null)

staff_pay_payment.name: staff_pay_payment
staff_pay_payment.value: ("staff_pay"."paid_on" is null) = ("staff_pay"."payment_method" is null) and ("staff_pay"."payment_method" is null or "staff_pay"."payment_method" <> 'bank_loan')

supplier_invoice_payment.name: supplier_invoice_payment
supplier_invoice_payment.value: ("supplier_invoice"."paid_on" is null) = ("supplier_invoice"."payment_method" is null) and ("supplier_invoice"."payment_method" is null or "supplier_invoice"."payment_method" <> 'bank_loan')

treasury_movement_transfer.name: treasury_movement_transfer
treasury_movement_transfer.value: ("treasury_movement"."kind" = 'transfer') = ("treasury_movement"."transfer_id" is not null and "treasury_movement"."counter_account_id" is not null)
